# List of deputy high commissioners of India to the United Kingdom__disambig_1

The deputy high commissioner of India to the United Kingdom is the deputy head of the High Commission of India to the United Kingdom. The Deputy High Commission is located at India House in London, United Kingdom. Typically, Deputy High Commissioner is the number-two diplomat assigned to the Indian High Commission in the United Kingdom and considered as the second-in-command to the high commissioner of India to the United Kingdom. The current deputy high commissioner is Sujit Ghosh.
